title: Chinese-Speaking Hackers Use Claude, Qwen and DeepSeek AI Agents to Attack Government Systems
content_md: Chinese-speaking threat operators have been observed using Claude, Qwen and DeepSeek-powered AI agents as operational components in a second intrusion campaign targeting government, political, education and industrial organizations across Asia. The campaign is distinct from an earlier operation reported in July that used Claude Code and DeepSeek against government and financial-sector targets.
